preparation_status.en: Preliminary concept, subject to further assessment
preparation_status.id: Konsep awal, masih memerlukan penilaian lebih lanjut

status_notice.en: Preliminary concept for discussion and project development. Not an approved or submission-ready GCF funding proposal.
status_notice.id: Konsep awal untuk diskusi dan pengembangan proyek. Bukan proposal pendanaan GCF yang disetujui atau siap diajukan.

template.preparation_status_basis: Template opening and concluding status; no published version number supplied. Snapshot version 1.

_note: Versioned implementation of the supplied eight-section preliminary concept template. Required/optional/conditional field treatment is an explicit ChatWater workflow policy, not a GCF submission checklist. Legacy gcf route is unchanged.

sections.guidance: Describe the project, location, service improvement, beneficiaries and investment uncertainty.
sections.guidance_id: Jelaskan proyek, lokasi, perbaikan layanan, penerima manfaat dan ketidakpastian investasi.

sections.guidance: Explain baseline problems, climate evidence, investment need and the distinction between evidence and assumptions.
sections.guidance_id: Jelaskan masalah garis dasar, bukti iklim, kebutuhan investasi; pisahkan bukti dan asumsi.

sections.guidance: State a measurable objective and connect each selected action to its purpose. Capacity building is conditional on an identified need.
sections.guidance_id: Nyatakan tujuan terukur dan kaitkan aksi dengan tujuannya. Pengembangan kapasitas sesuai kebutuhan.

sections.guidance: Distinguish baseline, individually estimated action benefits, and unverified targets. Do not sum overlapping benefits. Mitigation and adaptation claims are conditional on evidence.
sections.guidance_id: Pisahkan garis dasar, manfaat tiap aksi dan sasaran belum diverifikasi. Jangan jumlahkan manfaat tumpang tindih.

sections.guidance: Describe phases, proposed timing, owner and partners; do not imply institutional commitments.
sections.guidance_id: Jelaskan tahap, waktu, pemilik dan mitra yang diusulkan; jangan menganggap ada komitmen kelembagaan.

sections.guidance: Separate indicative costs, currency, uncertainty and potential financing. Contributions and co-financing amounts are optional if known; eligibility remains unconfirmed.
sections.guidance_id: Pisahkan biaya indikatif, mata uang, ketidakpastian dan calon pendanaan. Kontribusi opsional jika diketahui; kelayakan belum dikonfirmasi.

sections.guidance: List technical, cost, financing, capacity, social/environmental and climate risks with proposed responses, subject to assessment.
sections.guidance_id: Catat risiko teknis, biaya, pendanaan, kapasitas, sosial/lingkungan dan iklim beserta usulan respons.

sections.en: 8. Information Required for the Next Stage
sections.id: 8. Informasi yang Diperlukan untuk Tahap Berikutnya
sections.guidance: Identify baseline verification, design, feasibility, cost/benefit validation, institutions, safeguards, consultations and approvals still needed. Conclude with preparation limitations.
sections.guidance_id: Identifikasi verifikasi, desain, kelayakan, biaya/manfaat, lembaga, pengaman, konsultasi dan persetujuan yang masih diperlukan.
